_doc: Revert-verify mutants for the query predicate analyzer (RFC 308a52c3 «Загрузка по запросу», phase 1a, vault-exodev task 03523fef). Each mutant is a plausible wrong implementation of ONE guarantee and must redden exactly the axes in `expect` (pairwise distinct sets, ITRV §A147). PA axes judge the analyzer's verdict; PD axes judge the guarantee itself on the REAL engine through the CLI path (translate → AlgebraOptimizer.optimize → execute) — full store vs store cut to P'. PA0 and PA21 (fixture forms) have no mutant by design: they guard the fixture, not the subject. N-mutants come from the independent spec review; R-mutants and M43–M45 from the independent review of the implementation (round 1), with their witness axes PA21–PA41 / PD39–PD56; M46, M47, R49, E12 from round 2 (axes PD57–PD62); G6, G7, G11 from round 3 (axes PD63–PD65). `tree`/`subject` are placeholders — run the matrix on a copy with the paths substituted (§A145).
